answer: Agents register through a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave measurement, with timber as the identity state tree, juniper as its hash anchor, and fable as the verification contract. An adversary must provision distinct physical silicon and produce valid enclave quotes for each identity; replayed measurements are rejected. Registration bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, while forged or duplicated quotes trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
